reference.limits: "Dynamic rate limiting" on API and site; HTTP 429 `Too many requests` → wait minutes and retry. No published numbers. Competition submissions are capped per day by each competition's rules; GPU/TPU are weekly quotas (`get_accelerator_quota`). Terms of Use forbid crawling / scraping the Services and holding more than one active account (our tenants must use their OWN account — never the platform's — for submissions). No terms clause forbids automated API use; the API docs present it as the CI/CD path. Competition rules govern the rest (daily caps, external-data and licence clauses, team merges
mcp_sdk: Official remote MCP `https://www.kaggle.com/mcp` (docs https://www.kaggle.com/docs/mcp; setup `npx mcp-remote https://www.kaggle.com/mcp`
SDK / CLI https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-api (`pip install kaggle`). Community: Galaxy-Dawn/kaggle-mcp (adds discussion tools).

reason: No REST reference to map: https://www.kaggle.com/docs/api documents the kaggle CLI, kagglehub and the OAuth provider, and shows a single example request (`curl https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/list -H "Authorization: Bearer KGAT_..."`) without parameters or a response schema; the request/response contract lives only inside the kagglesdk client (the old KaggleSwagger.yaml is no longer published). Missing: a documented endpoint reference (paths, parameters, response shapes). Kaggle's official MCP server (https://www.kaggle.com/mcp) is the documented agent route.
